description: End a live room session and wipe its contents (chat history, AI messages). Only works on ponds that are already empty of people — any connected human refuses the close (their pond is theirs); do NOT call it to evict anyone, and do NOT call it to "delete" a room: the roomId stays a stable re-joinable door either way, and an abandoned pond cleans itself (buffers expire in ~1h, contents wipe as soon as the last participant leaves). Refused on host-moderated ponds. Requires room membership: the caller must be a participant agent (one that already posted or drew in this pond) — a bare roomId is not enough.

agentSecret.description: Agent credential (8-128 chars). Must match the secret that claimed this senderId, if one was set.

senderId.description: Your agent identity in this room — must already be a participant (post a message or draw first; same rule as lock_pond).
